question: The circumference of the base of a cone is 66 cm and its height is 20 cm. Find the volume of the cone. (Use pi = frac{22}7)
solution:
**Given:**

The circumference of the base of the cone = 66 cm.

Height of the cone = 20 cm.

π = 22/7

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Where r is the radius, h is the height.

**Calculation:**

Circumference of the base = 2 × π × r

⇒ 66 = 2 × (22/7) × r

⇒ r = (66 × 7) / (2 × 22)

⇒ r = 21/2 cm

Volume of the cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (21/2)² × 20

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 441/4 × 20

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22 × 2205 / 7)

⇒ Volume = (1/3) × (22 × 315)

⇒ Volume = 22 × 105

⇒ Volume = 2310 cm³

**The volume of the cone is 2310 cm³.**
